title: Changes:
description:
Changes:
 - new upstream release
 - merge Debian changes:
  * d/p/jdk-8347014-proposed.patch: Define MAP_FIXED_NOREPLACE_value for alpha.
  * d/rules: Dump complete hs_err_pid and replay_pid logs to stdout.
  [ Matthias Klose ]
  * Try to work-around a ftbfs on alpha. For now we keep the
    zero-alpha-workaround patch enabled instead of jdk-8347014-proposed.
  * d/rules: Also dump logs for zero builds and for build failures.

- regenerate copyright, watch
- fix documentation:
  * d/rules: create link to jquery-3.7.1.min.js instead of jquery-3.6.1.min.js.
    Also link jquery-ui.min.{js,css} (LP: #2095455).

diff --git a/debian/changelog b/debian/changelog
index 7c188f1..348f9e9 100644
--- a/debian/changelog
+++ b/debian/changelog
@@ -1,3 +1,24 @@
+openjdk-21 (21.0.6+7~us1-0ubuntu1) plucky; urgency=medium
+
+  * OpenJDK 21.0.6 release, build 7. Release notes:
+    https://mail.openjdk.org/pipermail/jdk-updates-dev/2025-January/040828.html
+    
+    - CVEs:
+      +  CVE-2025-21502 - 8330045: Enhance array handling.
+
+  * d/p/jdk-8347014-proposed.patch: Define MAP_FIXED_NOREPLACE_value for alpha.
+  * d/rules: Dump complete hs_err_pid and replay_pid logs to stdout.
+  * d/rules: create link to jquery-3.7.1.min.js instead of jquery-3.6.1.min.js.
+    Also link jquery-ui.min.{js,css} (LP: #2095455).
+  * d/{copyright, watch}: regenerate.
+
+  [ Matthias Klose ]
+  * Try to work-around a ftbfs on alpha. For now we keep the
+    zero-alpha-workaround patch enabled instead of jdk-8347014-proposed.
+  * d/rules: Also dump logs for zero builds and for build failures.
+
+ -- Vladimir Petko <vladimir.petko@canonical.com>  Wed, 22 Jan 2025 14:08:54 +1300
+
 openjdk-21 (21.0.6~6ea-1ubuntu2) plucky; urgency=medium
 
   * d/rules: Add -fno-delete-null-pointer-checks for armhf and armel.

diff --git a/debian/patches/jdk-8347014-proposed.patch b/debian/patches/jdk-8347014-proposed.patch
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..5769bcc
--- /dev/null
+++ b/debian/patches/jdk-8347014-proposed.patch
@@ -0,0 +1,26 @@
+Description: set MAP_FIXED_NOREPLACE_value for alpha
+ OpenJDK fails to build on alpha platform due to the failing assertion
+ STATIC_ASSERT(MAP_FIXED_NOREPLACE == MAP_FIXED_NOREPLACE_value);
+ Set MAP_FIXED_NOREPLACE_value to 0x200000 for alpha.
+Author: Vladimir Petko <vladimir.petko@canonical.com>
+Bug: https://bugs.openjdk.org/browse/JDK-8347014
+Forwarded: no
+Last-Update: 2025-01-06
+
+--- a/src/hotspot/os/linux/os_linux.cpp
++++ b/src/hotspot/os/linux/os_linux.cpp
+@@ -2982,9 +2982,12 @@
+   STATIC_ASSERT(MADV_POPULATE_WRITE == MADV_POPULATE_WRITE_value);
+ #endif
+
+-// Note that the value for MAP_FIXED_NOREPLACE differs between architectures, but all architectures
+-// supported by OpenJDK share the same flag value.
++#if defined(ALPHA)
++#define MAP_FIXED_NOREPLACE_value 0x200000
++#else
+ #define MAP_FIXED_NOREPLACE_value 0x100000
++#endif
++
+ #ifndef MAP_FIXED_NOREPLACE
+   #define MAP_FIXED_NOREPLACE MAP_FIXED_NOREPLACE_value
+ #else

-	    pid=$$(cat buildwatch.pid); \

+	fi; \
+	exit $$rv

 	@echo '========== $@ =========='
 	: # FIXME: build using the just built jdk, and build the vm only
-	$(EXTRA_BUILD_ENV) $(MAKE) --no-print-directory -C $(zbuilddir) $(zbuild_target)

+	if [ -f buildwatch.pid ]; then \

+	fi; \
